watch.summary: The creator reacts with hilarity as he misinterprets an esports team's huddle chant as 'ding dong chief'.

beats.what: The creator watches footage of an esports team and asks what they are saying.
The esports team shouts their pre-match huddle chant.
The creator yells 'Ding dong chief!' and bursts into laughter.
The creator laughs, admitting he isn't sure if that's really what they said.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedy stems from the creator's absurd mishearing of a team chant as 'ding dong chief'. His infectious laughter and sudden realization make the short moment charming.
